sponsored.t: Includes remedial services, homework or childcare as the transportation responsibility of the city school district located in a city having a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Includes remedial services, homework or childcare as the transportation responsibility of the city school district located in a city having a population of one million or more.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 85 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 3786, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to including remedi- al services, homework or childcare as the transportation responsi- bility of the city school district located in a city having a population of one million or more" NOT APPROVED This bill requires the City of New York, as part of its After 4pm busing program, to provide transportation or reimbursement for children attending public and nonpublic schools in grades K-6 not only for regu- larly scheduled classes, as is currently the case, but for the addi- tional purposes of receiving remedial services, completing homework, or receiving childcare. A significant program change of this nature is most appropriately addressed only in the context of budget negotiations. Therefore, I am…

sponsored.t: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered, inspected and insured
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered with the department of motor vehicles, inspected and have liability insurance; and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

sponsored.t: Permits persons 65 years of age to enroll in a limited number of state university and city university courses for credit without tuition
sponsored.sum: Permits persons 65 years of age or over to enroll in a limited number of state university and city university courses for credit without tuition.
sponsored.fis: There is no direct fiscal impact, because all attendance would be on a space-available basis.

sponsored.t: Requires notification of impending expiration of vehicle inspection
sponsored.sum: Establishes that the department of motor vehicles shall notify individuals via postal mail or electronic notification that their vehicle inspection is subject to expiration thirty days before such expiration; provides for a five day grace period after the expiration of the vehicle inspection certificate wherein operators of such vehicle shall not be fined.

sponsored.t: Includes the attacks on September 11, 2001 in courses of instruction in patriotism and citizenship
sponsored.sum: Includes the attacks on September 11, 2001 in courses of instruction in patriotism and citizenship.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax exemption amount on clothing and apparel items from one hundred ten dollars to two hundred dollars.

sponsored.t: Requiring a police officer to be present at schools within the city of New York during instructional hours
sponsored.sum: Requires a police officer to be present at schools within the city of New York during instructional hours and at least one hour prior and one hour after such instructional hours.
sponsored.fis: There are no costs to the state or localities.

sponsored.t: Requires all persons in a city having a population of one million or more operating a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter to wear a helmet
sponsored.sum: Requires all persons in a city having a population of one million or more operating a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter to wear a helmet; imposes a civil penalty for violation of such requirement.

sponsored.t: Requires license plates for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires license plates for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in New York city; requires a one time registration; requires a registration fee for such license plates.

sponsored.t: Requires liability insurance for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in cities having a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Requires liability insurance for bicycles, bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in cities having a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Establishes a bicycle and electric scooter operator's safety manual and licensing requirement
sponsored.sum: Establishes a bicycle and electric scooter operator's safety manual; provides for the issuance of a license for residents who successfully read and comprehend the operator's safety manual; requires residents who operate a bicycle, bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter in New York City to have a license to operate such devices.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the operation of a bicycle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of a bicycle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs; applies upon public highways, private roads open to motor vehicle traffic, any other parking lot, and sidewalks.

sponsored.t: Requires every case of an injury arising from or caused by a bicycle with electric assist, an electric scooter or limited use motorcycle to be reported at once to the police authorities
sponsored.sum: Requires every case of an injury arising from or caused by a bicycle with electric assist, an electric scooter or limited use motorcycle to be reported at once to the police authorities of the city, town or village where the person reporting is located; provides that the failure to report shall be a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Authorizes drivers to disobey a traffic-control device or signal, after exercising reasonable care, in order to yield the right of way to an authorized emergency vehicle
sponsored.sum: Authorizes drivers to disobey a traffic-control device or signal, after exercising reasonable care, in order to yield the right of way to an authorized emergency vehicle.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain surcharges on credit or debit card transactions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain surcharges on certain credit or debit card transactions in the city of New York; provides that no agency or department of the city of New York, or any tribunal located therein, shall be authorized to impose a surcharge on a holder who elects to use a credit or debit card in lieu of payment by cash, check, or similar means to pay any fine, civil penalty, or fee owed.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax exemption for pensions and annuities for persons age fifty-nine and one-half or greater
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax exemption for pensions and annuities for persons age fifty-nine and one-half or greater from $20,000 to $25,000 in 2027, $30,000 in 2028, $35,000 in 2029 and $40,000 for each subsequent year.

sponsored.t: Establishes the prohibition against requiring a permit for the singing of the national anthem or the reciting of the pledge of allegiance
sponsored.sum: Establishes the prohibition against requiring a permit for the singing of the national anthem or the reciting of the pledge of allegiance.

sponsored.t: Requires all agencies of the city of New York which issue summons to document violations with photographic evidence when feasible
sponsored.sum: Requires all agencies of the city of New York which issue summons to document violations with photographic evidence when feasible.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for certain volunteers who provide at least twenty-five hours of service during the year
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for certain volunteers at 501(c)(3) organizations or organizations affiliated with NY Cares or NY Service who provide at least twenty-five hours of service during the year.

sponsored.t: Increases the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; increases the amount of the credit from $200 to $500 for single filers and from $400 to $1,000 for spouses filing jointly.

sponsored.t: Enacts the family court adjusted service time (FAST) act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "family court adjusted service time (FAST) act"; requires family courts in New York City to remain open until midnight on at least one weekday each week in at least two counties effective January 1, 2026, and in at least three counties, effective January 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of finance of the city of New York to establish a property tax amnesty program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of finance of the city of New York to establish a property tax amnesty program; provides that such program shall last for 4 months and shall forgive up to $1000 of interest on a delinquent tax bill if 100 percent of the principal bill is paid.

sponsored.t: Establishes a credit for the purchase and installation of a security alarm system
sponsored.sum: Establishes a credit for the purchase and installation of a security alarm system equal to two hundred fifty dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification requirements for traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices and photo speed violation monitoring systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to notification requirements for traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices and photo speed violation monitoring systems.

sponsored.t: Establishes active shooter drills in educational institutions
sponsored.sum: Establishes active shooter drills in public and private educational institutions.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues and trauma informed care
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues and trauma informed care.

sponsored.t: Requires that academic credit toward a high school diploma be given for practical experience gained outside of school during high school
sponsored.sum: Requires that academic credit toward a high school diploma be given for practical experience gained outside of school during high school.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to study and report on the provision of services to public school students in grades 8 through 12 by guidance counselors
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to study and report on the provision of services to public school students in grades 8 through 12 by guidance counselors.

sponsored.t: Relates to curb repair in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to curb repair in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to a privately owned vacant property temporary public benefit use exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to a privately owned vacant property temporary public benefit use exemption.

sponsored.t: Abolishes the minimum charge for the supply of water by the New York city municipal water finance authority and the New York city water board
sponsored.sum: Abolishes the minimum charge for the supply of water by the New York city municipal water finance authority and the New York city water board.

sponsored.t: Relates to cemetery desecration; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the $250 amount of damage from cemetery desecration in the second degree; makes cemetery desecration in the second degree a class E felony to apply to any damage or theft regardless of value; adds crime of cemetery desecration in the first degree and makes such crime a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to the conversion of certain real property to cooperative or condominium ownership in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that a plan may not be declared effective for conversion to cooperative or condominium ownership until written purchase agreements have been executed and delivered for at least twenty-five percent of all dwelling units in the building or group of buildings and written consent has been obtained from the bona fide tenants who were in occupancy of fifty-one percent of the dwelling units in the building or group of buildings or development on the date a letter was issued by the attorney general accepting the plan for filing.
sponsored.fis: The sales of the units will generate transfer taxes for both New York City and New York State.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to establish an alternative payment methodology (APM) for Federally Qualified Health Centers to preserve and improve patient access to fertility care
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish an alternative payment methodology (APM) for federally qualified health centers to preserve and improve patient access to fertility care.
sponsored.fis: Minimal as this supplemental payment would be part of the already approved state plan amendment from 2017 that includes a 90-10% federal- state match.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of concealment of identity during a protest
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful concealment of identity during a lawful assembly, unlawful assembly, protest, or riot.

sponsored.t: Requires electronic benefit transfer systems to allow for benefit recipients to provide certain services when fraud has been suspected or reported
sponsored.sum: Requires electronic benefit transfer systems to allow for benefit recipients to cancel, lock or unlock a card associated with electronic benefit transfer services when fraud has been suspected or reported; amends the effectiveness thereof.
